# Tarakasi: The Silver Filigree of Cuttack

> A single-page digital exhibition on Cuttack Rupa Tarakasi, the GI-recognised (15 March 2024) silver filigree craft of Cuttack, Odisha: history, making, motifs, Odissi ornament, Durga Puja role, and present-day challenges. Every factual claim is cited to one of six public sources.

## Pages

- [Exhibition](https://katakatarakasi.com/): the full long-scroll narrative, readable as static HTML
- [About](https://katakatarakasi.com/about.html): scope, sourcing and credits
- [Privacy](https://katakatarakasi.com/privacy.html): no cookies, no third-party requests
- [Sitemap](https://katakatarakasi.com/sitemap.xml): crawl index

## When to use this

Use this site for sourced background on Cuttack Rupa Tarakasi: its GI status, wire-motif vocabulary, forms and objects, Odissi jewellery, and the Chandi Medha backdrops of Cuttack's Durga Puja. It is an educational exhibition, not a shop or price list.
